In this thrilling series, Goku and his friends face new challenges as they battle against various villains who seek to destroy or conquer the planet. With his incredible abilities and unwavering determination, Goku must use all his skills to prevent these villains from achieving their goals. As the battle rages on, Goku must summon all his strength to save the Earth from destruction.
